name: Asking Questions & Defining Problems
short_description: Formulate investigable questions and define engineering problems for study.
definition: Students ask scientific questions that can be investigated and define engineering problems that can be solved through design. This practice initiates inquiry and guides the direction of investigations and solutions.

name: Developing and Using Models
short_description: Create, use, and refine models to represent and explain systems or phenomena.
definition: Students develop and use models to describe, test, and predict phenomena. Models can be physical, mathematical, or conceptual and help visualize and explain complex systems.

name: Planning and Carrying Out Investigations
short_description: Design and conduct investigations to collect evidence and answer questions.
definition: Students plan and carry out investigations individually and collaboratively to produce data as evidence. This includes identifying variables, collecting data, and using appropriate tools and techniques.

name: Analyzing and Interpreting Data
short_description: Analyze and interpret data to identify patterns and draw conclusions.
definition: Students analyze and interpret data from investigations using tools, technologies, and statistical methods. This practice helps identify patterns, relationships, and evidence to support explanations.

name: Using Mathematics and Computational Thinking
short_description: Apply mathematical and computational methods to analyze and solve problems.
definition: Students use mathematical reasoning and computational tools to analyze data, represent relationships, and solve scientific and engineering problems.

name: Constructing Explanations and Designing Solutions
short_description: Develop scientific explanations and design solutions based on evidence.
definition: Students construct scientific explanations based on evidence and design engineering solutions that meet criteria and constraints. This practice connects evidence to reasoning and problem-solving.

name: Engaging in Argument from Evidence
short_description: Use evidence and reasoning to support or critique claims and solutions.
definition: Students engage in scientific argumentation by evaluating and critiquing evidence, reasoning, and claims. This practice strengthens understanding and supports decision-making.

name: Obtaining, Evaluating, and Communicating Information
short_description: Gather, assess, and share scientific and technical information clearly.
definition: Students obtain, evaluate, and communicate scientific and technical information from multiple sources. This practice includes reading, interpreting, and presenting information clearly and accurately.
